entities.name: Query RlmN-like protein
observations: The 360-residue sequence contains an RlmN_N domain at positions 12–65 and a Radical_SAM domain at positions 114–278.
The sequence has a cysteine-rich region consistent with coordination of a radical-SAM [4Fe-4S] cluster.
Homology to reviewed RlmN proteins is strong: 45.8–49.5% identity over 89.7–95.0% query coverage, with E-values around 10^-92 to 10^-93.
Best-supported functional assignment is a dual-specificity RNA methyltransferase catalyzing C2 methylation of adenosine in 23S rRNA and tRNA.
Sequence-derived properties: 360 aa, estimated molecular mass 39.1 kDa, theoretical pI 9.11.

entities.name: RlmN
observations: Reviewed homologs Q67PQ7, Q7UHU7, and Q6MDD0 are annotated as probable dual-specificity RNA methyltransferases.
RlmN uses S-adenosyl-L-methionine and a [4Fe-4S] cluster in a radical-SAM-dependent methylation mechanism involving an S-methylcysteine intermediate.
The annotated substrates are adenine 2503 in 23S rRNA and adenine 37 in tRNA; EC 2.1.1.192.

entities.name: RlmN RNA adenine methylation
observations: 23S rRNA adenosine 2503 + SAM is converted to 2-methyladenosine 2503 in 23S rRNA, with methionine, 5'-deoxyadenosine, S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine, and oxidized electron-transfer cofactors as products in the mapped radical-SAM reaction.
tRNA adenosine 37 + SAM is converted to 2-methyladenosine 37 in tRNA, with analogous radical-SAM products.
Mapped EC number is 2.1.1.192; Rhea mappings include RHEA:42916 and RHEA:43332.
